equities.name: TSX Composite
equities.commentary: The S&P/TSX Composite closed at 33,477.71 on April 9, 2026, advancing 1.12% week-over-week and 41.10% year-over-year — the highest year-over-year reading among the four North American benchmarks tracked this week1. The index sits 3.1% below its 52-week high of 34,541.30 set on March 2, 2026, and 45.5% above its 52-week low of 23,014.90 recorded on April 10, 20251. The weekly move developed as the latest Statistics Canada monthly GDP release showed mining, quarrying, and oil and gas extraction up 1.2% month-over-month against construction up 1.1% month-over-month, even as the headline monthly GDP print contracted 0.6%2. The Signal Dispatch cross-reference engine links the benchmark advance to 428 projects tracked in mining, quarrying, and oil and gas extraction at a combined C$259.7 billion, plus 1,687 infrastructure projects tracked at C$179.0 billion and 802 utilities projects tracked at C$507.7 billion3. If the index holds above the 33,000 level amid the Bank of Canada overnight rate held at 2.25% for a seventh consecutive meeting, the 211 residential projects tracked at C$44.4 billion would continue to carry financing exposure tied to the 2Y Government of Canada yield of 2.95%4.

equities.name: S&P 500
equities.commentary: The S&P 500 closed at 6,824.66 on April 9, 2026, advancing 3.68% on the week and 25.06% year-over-year5. The advance developed as the federal funds rate sat at 3.64% per the February 2026 Federal Reserve print, a differential of 139 basis points above the Bank of Canada overnight rate of 2.25%6. The benchmark sits 2.2% below its 52-week high of 6,978.60 set on January 27, 2026, and 32.3% above its 52-week low of 5,158.20 recorded on April 21, 2025 — the first weekly close above 6,800 since the late-January 2026 peak5.

equities.name: DJIA
equities.commentary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at 48,185.80 on April 9, 2026, advancing 3.61% on the week and 18.66% year-over-year7. The move developed as industrial and healthcare components repriced amid the February 2026 US unemployment reading of 4.4% and the federal funds rate print of 3.64%6. The 30-stock benchmark sits 4.0% below its 52-week high of 50,188.14 set on February 10, 2026, and 26.2% above its 52-week low of 38,170.41 recorded on April 21, 20257.

equities.name: Nasdaq Composite
equities.commentary: The Nasdaq Composite closed at 22,822.42 on April 9, 2026, advancing 4.31% on the week and 33.27% year-over-year8. The advance led the four North American benchmarks on the week, reflecting weekly repricing across technology components following the February 2026 federal funds rate print of 3.64%6. The index sits 4.7% below its 52-week high of 23,958.47 set on October 29, 2025, and 43.8% above its 52-week low of 15,870.90 recorded on April 21, 20258.
